attributes.board_name: Pennsylvania State Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved: preapproved providers (APTA and components, FSBPT and its jurisdictions, CAPTE-accredited PT/PTA programs, AHA/Red Cross for emergency-response training only, APTA-credentialed residencies/fellowships, ABPTS specialty certification, courses certified by FSBPT ProCert or approved by FSBPT jurisdictions or APTA components), Board-approved courses, and authored publications. 1 contact hour = 60 minutes; 1 academic semester credit = 15 contact hours. Teaching a course earns attendee credit plus preparation time (up to the same amount). Clinical instruction: 1 contact hour per 40 hours, max 4 per biennium. Office management or practice-building courses do not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required during the biennial renewal cycle in which the licensee was first licensed.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: a contact hour counts only for the biennium in which it was completed.
rules.audit_note: Licensee verifies CE compliance on the biennial renewal application; the Board audits and the licensee must respond within 30 days. Keep proof 5 years. The Board will not renew a license without the required CE.

topics.who: Law or ethics applicable to the practice of physical therapy
Child abuse recognition and reporting course approved by the Department of State (BPOA) with the Department of Human Services (49 Pa. Code §40.208(b)); 3 hours required once for initial licensure

rules.notes: Licenses expire December 31 of each even-numbered year. Direct access certificate holders (practice without referral): of the same 30 contact hours, at least 10 must be in evaluative procedures to treat a person without a referral (49 Pa. Code §40.63). Waivers/extensions for illness or hardship on written request at least 90 days before renewal.
